name: @suhail-akhtar/aico
description: AI Coder — multi-provider coding assistant CLI (Claude Code compatible). Supports OpenRouter, Anthropic, OpenAI, Gemini, Z.AI (GLM), Ollama.
author: Suhail Akhtar

scripts.test: npx tsup src/test-exports.ts --format esm --outDir dist-test --clean --target node18 && node --input-type=commonjs -e "const fs=require('fs');fs.cpSync('src/skills/builtin','dist-test/builtin',{recursive:true})" && node test-harness.mjs && node scripts/title-sanitizer-probe.mjs
scripts.bench: npm run build && npx tsup src/test-exports.ts --format esm --outDir dist-test --clean --target node18 && node --input-type=commonjs -e "const fs=require('fs');fs.cpSync('src/skills/builtin','dist-test/builtin',{recursive:true})" && node bench.mjs
scripts.test:live: npm run build && npx tsup src/test-exports.ts --format esm --outDir dist-test --clean --target node18 && node live-test.mjs
scripts.prepare: node -e "process.exit(require('fs').existsSync('src')?0:1)" && npm --prefix web install --no-audit --no-fund && npm run build && npm run build:web || exit 0
scripts.test:web: npm run build:web && npx tsup src/server/index.ts --format esm --outDir dist-test/server --target node18 --clean && node --input-type=commonjs -e "const fs=require('fs');fs.cpSync('src/skills/builtin','dist-test/server/builtin',{recursive:true})" && node web-live-test.mjs
scripts.test:web:unit: npm --prefix web exec -- esbuild web/src/reduce.ts --bundle --format=esm --outfile=web/dist-test/reduce.mjs --log-level=error && npm --prefix web exec -- esbuild web/src/grouping.ts --bundle --format=esm --outfile=web/dist-test/grouping.mjs --log-level=error && npm --prefix web exec -- esbuild web/src/session-memory.ts --bundle --format=esm --outfile=web/dist-test/session-memory.mjs --log-level=error && npm --prefix web exec -- esbuild web/src/settings-schema.ts --bundle --format=esm --outfile=web/dist-test/settings-schema.mjs --log-level=error && npm --prefix web exec -- esbuild web/src/todos.ts --bundle --format=esm --outfile=web/dist-test/todos.mjs --log-level=error && npm --prefix web exec -- esbuild web/src/plans.ts --bundle --format=esm --outfile=web/dist-test/plans.mjs --log-level=error && npm --prefix web exec -- esbuild web/src/checks.ts --bundle --format=esm --outfile=web/dist-test/checks.mjs --log-level=error && npm --prefix web exec -- esbuild web/src/turn-state.ts --bundle --format=esm --outfile=web/dist-test/turn-state.mjs --log-level=error && npm --prefix web exec -- esbuild web/src/agents.ts --bundle --format=esm --outfile=web/dist-test/agents.mjs --log-level=error && npm --prefix web exec -- esbuild shared/ui/tool-result.ts --bundle --format=esm --outfile=web/dist-test/tool-result.mjs --log-level=error && node web/test-reduce.mjs && node web/test-ui.mjs
